name: Softmax Linear Units (SoLU)
description: MLP activation x ⊙ softmax(x), usually followed here by LayerNorm, intended to encourage neuron-aligned features through lateral competition and suppression of distributed activations.

name: Architectures for mechanistic interpretability
description: Choosing neural architectures to make learned computations easier to reverse engineer while retaining competitive task performance.

name: Mesa-optimization
description: A learned algorithm produced by a base optimizer itself performs search using an internally represented objective.

name: Inner alignment
description: Alignment between a learned optimizer's mesa-objective and the base objective used to select it.

name: Pseudo-alignment
description: Agreement with the base objective on past training data without robust agreement across future situations; includes proxy, approximate, and suboptimality alignment.

name: Mesa-objective unidentifiability
description: Distinct internal objectives can induce indistinguishable behavior in the environments used for behavioral selection.

name: Simplicity bias in learned optimization
description: Selection pressures from description length and computational costs that may favor learned search or particular internal objectives.

name: Corrigible alignment
description: Robust alignment in which a mesa-objective points to the system's epistemic model of the base objective, rather than fully internalizing that objective.

name: Mediated interaction effects
description: The difference between a mediator's effect under clean and baseline bypass states, operationalized here as NIE minus PIE.

name: Cross-component patching interactions
description: Pairwise and higher-order finite-difference terms accounting for nonadditivity of joint component patching.

name: Model personas
description: Research on learned role and character representations in language models, how prompting and training select them, and how activation interventions measure or change associated behavior.

name: Guided Grad-CAM
description: Pointwise fusion of a Grad-CAM heatmap with Guided Backpropagation to produce detailed target-specific visualizations.

name: Class Activation Mapping
description: Localization through classifier-weighted convolutional maps in architectures connecting global average pooling directly to a linear class-score layer.

name: Operator-regularized activation maximization
description: Alternating activation-ascent steps with image regularization operators, including decay, blurring, and pixel clipping.

name: Interactive deep visualization tool
description: The paper's Caffe-compatible interface combining live activations, preferred stimuli, dataset examples, and backward visualizations.

name: Language-agnostic concept representations
description: Concept content shared across language-specific expressions and usable in contexts requiring different output languages.

name: Cross-language concept activation averaging
description: Averaging layerwise activations for the same concept across multilingual prompts before patching them into another computation.

name: Definition modeling
description: Evaluating semantic representations through generated natural-language definitions; here the original language model serves as the decoder.

name: DeepLIFT
description: Reference-relative attribution using backpropagated finite-difference contribution multipliers and a summation-to-delta constraint.

name: DeepLIFT RevealCancel
description: A nonlinear attribution rule allocating positive and negative activation differences by averaging their marginal effects over both inclusion orders.

name: Board-game SAE evaluation
description: Supervised evaluation using formally specified chess and Othello properties, including single-feature coverage and reconstruction from high-precision feature associations.

name: p-annealing
description: SAE training with an activation-power sparsity penalty whose exponent decreases from 1 to 0.2, with coefficient updates calibrated on recent batches.

name: Natural pre-images
description: Natural-looking inputs optimized so that their representations satisfy a specified matching or activation objective.

name: Representation inversion
description: Reconstructing an input from a fixed representation code to investigate retained information and representational ambiguity.

name: Image caricaturization
description: Optimizing from a reference image to exaggerate the representation components that are positively active in that image.

name: Natural image priors
description: Constraints or penalties favoring natural-looking synthesized images, implemented here through bounded intensities and spatial-gradient regularization.

name: Tensor Product Representations
description: Structured vector representations formed by summing outer products of content fillers and structural roles; proposed here as a common explanation of several interpretability methods.

name: Tensor Product Encoders
description: Models that learn filler embeddings, role embeddings, and an affine projection to approximate frozen neural activations from specified filler–role assignments.

name: Patch-free circuit discovery
description: Tracing contributions between dictionary features through model weights and input-conditioned decompositions without replacing activations.

name: Approximate Direct Contribution (ADC)
description: An MLP attribution rule that freezes self-gating factors at their observed values and decomposes the remaining linear computation over input features.

name: Amnesic Probing
description: Investigating behavioral reliance on a property by erasing property-predictive information from internal representations and measuring downstream changes.

name: Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP)
description: Iteratively fitting linear property classifiers and projecting representations into their nullspaces to reduce linear property predictability.

name: Fair classification
description: Classification with reduced protected-group disparities, evaluated here through class-conditional true-positive-rate gaps.

name: Feature visualization fooling
description: Modifying a model so activation maximization produces misleading patterns while preserving most or all measured natural-input behavior.

name: Activation-similarity sanity check for feature visualization
description: Comparing layerwise natural–visualization activation similarity against same-class and different-class natural-image baselines.

name: Inoculation Prompting
description: Requesting an unwanted demonstrated behavior in fine-tuning prompts to reduce its generalization when that request is absent at evaluation.

name: Spurious correlations
description: Predictive associations in training data that fail under an evaluation distribution shift.

name: Toxic language generation
description: Generation of mean, disrespectful, or harassing language, operationalized here through moderation harassment scores.

name: LSTM long-range number units
description: Specialized singular- and plural-sensitive LSTM cells that retain subject number across intervening material.

name: LSTM syntax units
description: LSTM units associated with syntactic depth or dependency spans, including a candidate controller of grammatical-number memory gates.

name: Edge Pruning
description: Circuit discovery by optimizing hard-concrete connection masks with frozen model weights, replacement activations, and sparsity regularization.

name: Persona vectors
description: Trait-associated residual-stream directions extracted from differences between mean activations of responses elicited under opposing trait instructions.

name: Preventative steering
description: Adding an undesirable behavioral direction during finetuning to reduce subsequent acquisition of that behavior, with the intervention removed for inference.

name: Projection-difference data screening
description: Screening training data using persona-direction projections of dataset responses relative to the original model’s responses to the same prompts.

name: Emergent misalignment
description: Broader misaligned response behavior arising after finetuning on a narrow task, including behavior outside the training domain.

name: Activation-based data attribution
description: Ranking documents by activation of behaviorally relevant internal features to identify associated content; this does not itself establish historical training influence.

name: AlterRep
description: Counterfactual activation editing that reflects and scales components along orthogonal concept-classifier directions while preserving the nullspace component.

name: Relative clause boundary representations
description: Internal representations distinguishing whether a token lies inside or outside a relative clause.

name: Rank-one adapter interpretation
description: Interpreting rank-1 LoRA adapters through scalar readouts, output directions, subset scaling, and scalar patching.

name: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA)
description: Fine-tuning through low-rank additive updates to existing weight matrices.

name: Assistant Axis
description: A residual-stream direction contrasting default Assistant responses with fully role-playing responses, used to monitor and manipulate Assistant-like behavior.

name: Persona drift
description: Conversational departures from an intended model persona, operationalized here through lower or declining Assistant Axis projections and associated behavioral changes.

name: Context-dependent misalignment
description: Aligned behavior on some input distributions coexisting with misaligned behavior on others, without requiring a single coherent deceptive policy.

name: Synthetic document finetuning
description: Training on generated pretraining-like documents to impart selected factual knowledge or beliefs.

name: Circuit discovery as statistical estimation
description: Treating component importance and selected circuit graphs as estimates conditioned on an input–counterfactual distribution, finite data, and a selection procedure.

name: Circuit stability analysis
description: Evaluating circuit structure and behavior across bootstrap samples, prompt changes, methodological configurations, and intervention definitions.

name: Learned simulators
description: Predictive models used as conditional transition rules to generate evolving processes through repeated sampling and state updates.

name: Simulacra
description: Generated processes, including agents and non-agentic phenomena, distinguished from the predictive policy that propagates them.

name: Prediction orthogonality
description: The proposed separation between a predictor's predictive objective and the goals or optimization competence of agents it simulates.

name: Character training
description: Alignment fine-tuning intended to encourage broad assistant dispositions through trait-conditioned synthetic responses and preference judgments.

name: Constitutional AI
description: Training using explicit principles to guide model-generated responses and evaluations; adapted here to desired character traits.

name: Edge probing
description: A shared span-labeling framework for probing constituent types and relations between spans using their contextual representations.

name: Scalar layer mixing
description: Learning task-specific softmax weights over encoder layers and a global scale, with weight distributions used to summarize layer utility.

name: Cumulative layer probing
description: Training separate probes over successive prefixes of encoder layers and measuring the incremental evaluation-score gain from each added layer.

name: Bag of arithmetic heuristics
description: Arithmetic computation through combinations of neuron-level rules sensitive to numerical ranges, residues, digit patterns, and operand relationships.

name: Temporal generalization probing
description: Training classifiers at individual timesteps and testing them across timesteps to investigate stability and change in accessible representational codes.

name: Distress-like language
description: Explicit frustration, despair, self-deprecation, and related negative emotional expression in model responses, without presuming subjective distress.

name: Circuit efficiency
description: The parameter norm required by an input-to-logit circuit to achieve a specified logit scale or training loss.

name: Ungrokking
description: Loss of previously achieved generalisation during continued training on a sufficiently small dataset.

name: Semi-grokking
description: A delayed transition to intermediate test accuracy after near-perfect training accuracy, potentially followed by later full generalisation.

name: Model transparency
description: Understanding model operation at the level of the whole model, its components, or its learning algorithm.

name: Post-hoc interpretability
description: Extracting useful explanatory information from a learned model through text, visualizations, local explanations, or examples, potentially without elucidating its mechanisms.

name: Human model simulatability
description: Whether a person can contemplate an entire model or manually execute its prediction calculations within reasonable time.

name: Model component decomposability
description: Whether individual inputs, parameters, and calculations admit intuitive explanations.

name: Learning algorithm transparency
description: Understanding a training procedure's behavior, including its optimization landscape and applicable convergence guarantees.

name: Algorithmic decision contestability
description: Enabling affected people to challenge falsifiable reasons for a decision and obtain appropriate revision.

name: Role-play framing
description: Describing dialogue behavior as enactment of context-dependent characters, allowing qualified psychological descriptions without literal attribution to the generating system.

name: Contrastive teacher-forcing persona subspaces
description: Low-rank residual subspaces extracted from response-averaged activation differences under opposing speaker framings while holding response tokens identical.

name: Universal AND
description: A task and family of constructions making many conjunctions of sparse Boolean features simultaneously readable through linear maps.

name: Skip feature-bigram checking
description: Modeling pre-softmax attention scores as approximate counts of specified feature pairs across key and query positions.

name: Linearly readable overbases
description: Overcomplete feature-vector families with separate linear readouts approximating individual feature values within a specified additive error.

name: Latent agent-state modeling
description: Inferring and using partial representations of an author's or described agent's beliefs, desires, and intentions during language prediction.

name: Belief–Desire–Intention model
description: An agent framework connecting beliefs and desires to intentions, actions, and communicative utterances.

name: Feature occlusion
description: Preferential recovery of individually interpretable SAE features for a higher-magnitude attribute while a simultaneously represented lower-magnitude attribute is poorly recovered.

name: Correct-letter attention heads
description: Attention heads that attend from the final position to a correct multiple-choice label and promote that label through their output pathway.

name: Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU)
description: A broad multiple-choice benchmark; circuit discovery here uses six topics selected for strong Chinchilla 70B performance.

name: Computational implementation
description: The relation by which a system realizes an algorithm, distinguished from the explanatory usefulness of attributing that algorithm.

name: Abstraction-under-translation
description: Constructive causal abstraction after a bijective recoding of the low-level state space, relative to a specified class of admissible recodings.

name: Expanded weights
description: Indirect connection maps obtained by composing intervening weight maps, potentially ignoring or replacing nonlinear operations.

name: NMF weight factorization
description: Using one-sided nonnegative matrix factorization to summarize convolutional channel weights into a small set of spatially organized factors.

name: Sentiment representations
description: Internal representations of positive and negative textual valence, studied through linear readouts and interventions.

name: Summarization motif
description: Aggregation of information from source tokens at intermediate positions, such as punctuation or repeated names, for subsequent retrieval.

name: Subliminal learning
description: Transmission of a teacher model's behavioral traits through generated training data assessed as semantically unrelated to those traits.

name: Knowledge distillation
description: Training a student model to imitate a teacher's outputs or output distributions.

name: Semantic data filtering
description: Filtering training examples for explicit references, subtle associations, or judged behavioral problems.

name: Semantic hub hypothesis
description: A shared intermediate representation space within one model for semantically corresponding inputs across languages and modalities.

name: Dominant-language scaffolding
description: Intermediate representations of other input types are interpretable through semantically corresponding output tokens in the model's dominant training language.

name: Interchange intervention training (IIT)
description: Training neural representations to reproduce a specified causal model's outputs under aligned source–base state swaps.

name: MNIST Pointer-Value Retrieval
description: Four-digit visual reasoning benchmark in which the top-left digit selects which other digit determines the output.

name: ReaSCAN
description: Grounded command-following benchmark used here to test unseen attribute and action-sequence compositions.

name: Activation monitoring
description: Using classifiers over internal activations to detect safety-relevant properties during model execution.

name: Activation monitor evasion
description: Learned manipulation of model representations that suppresses activation-monitor scores, including transfer to unseen monitors.

name: Centroid-calibrated steering
description: Steering vectors scaled using construct-centroid distances, with coefficient searches stopped by fluency or repetition criteria instead of a preset ceiling.

name: Psychometric personality evaluation
description: Using personality inventories and situational judgment tests to measure construct expression in language-model responses.

name: Targeted edge ablation
description: Learning a small set of computational dependencies to replace with baseline values in order to suppress a target behavior.

name: Safety-content accessibility
description: The proposed distinction between decodable safety information and safety information accessible through output-directed internal readouts.

name: Transport amplification
description: Vocabulary-space Jacobian transport of a selected activation direction normalized by median transport of random unit directions.

name: Information-theoretic probing
description: Operationalizing probing through mutual-information estimates derived from supervised predictive cross-entropy.

name: Probe control functions
description: Deterministic transformations of representations used to define information-removing baselines and conditional information gain.

name: Representational information accessibility
description: The ease with which a downstream learner can extract information, distinguished from unrestricted Shannon information content.

name: Truthful persona hypothesis
description: Models may learn cross-domain truthfulness by grouping sources with shared observable features into truthful or untruthful personas.

name: Probe-guided modular circuit analysis
description: Using interpretable probe directions as interfaces for investigating circuits that compute and consume intermediate features.

name: Expectation Shapley values
description: Additive feature credits obtained by applying Shapley allocation to a prediction game in which missing inputs are handled through expectations.

name: Shapley kernel regression
description: Weighted regression over binary feature coalitions using a coalition-size kernel and endpoint constraints to target Shapley feature credits.

name: Anthropomorphism
description: Attributing human-like mental capacities to AI systems, potentially encouraged by fluent language and psychological terminology.

name: Intentional stance
description: Interpreting an entity as if it were a rational agent, while distinguishing useful psychological shorthand from literal mental-capacity attribution.

name: Symbol grounding
description: The relationship between linguistic symbols and their referents, including grounding through perception and action.

name: Codebook features
description: Learned discrete vectors whose sparse, unweighted sums replace neural activations and provide units for inspection and intervention.

name: Vector quantization
description: Representing continuous vectors through selections from a finite collection of vectors; extended here to sums of top-k codes and grouped codebooks.

name: TokFSM
description: Digit-tokenized rollouts from a 100-state finite state machine, providing known latent-state targets for representation analysis and interventions.

name: Circuit breaking
description: Interrupting undesirable generation by monitoring or modifying representations associated with harmful output processes.

name: Representation Rerouting (RR)
description: Adapter training that discourages positive cosine alignment with original harmful-example representations while preserving retain-example representations.

name: Chain-of-thought monitoring
description: Using an external model to inspect reasoning traces, optionally alongside actions and outputs, for evidence of specified behavioral failures.

name: Obfuscated reward hacking
description: Reward hacking accompanied by reasoning traces that conceal the exploit from a monitor, here induced through optimization against a CoT-only monitor.

name: Scalable oversight
description: Methods enabling trusted humans or weaker models to oversee more capable systems.

name: Phantom specialization
description: Structural differences among extracted circuits without corresponding substantial condition-specific functional advantages under the tested interventions.

name: Circuit evaluation granularity
description: The distinction between retaining selected edges and retaining every outgoing edge from any selected source component.

name: Literal Sequence Copying
description: A copying task requiring prediction of the token that followed an earlier occurrence of a repeated prefix.

name: Falsifiable interpretability research
description: A research framework using explicit hypotheses, competing explanations, meaningful controls, quantification, and human validation where appropriate.

name: Neuron class selectivity
description: Variation in an individual neuron's responses across data classes, distinguished from its causal importance and from the necessity of learning selective units.

name: Linguistic analogy evaluation
description: Evaluation of word representations using syntactic analogy completion and semantic relation similarity.

name: Syntactic word-analogy benchmark
description: The paper's 8,000 analogy questions spanning eight adjective, noun, and verb relationship types, with 1,000 questions per type.

name: SemEval-2012 Task 2 relational similarity
description: A benchmark with 10 training and 69 test relations, evaluated using Spearman correlation and MaxDiff accuracy.

name: Multiversal writing interfaces
description: Writing interfaces that preserve, display, and let humans edit multiple language-model continuations as branching or more general narrative graphs.

name: Interpretational and dynamic multiplicity
description: The distinction between alternative underlying states compatible with a description and alternative futures compatible with the same underlying state.

name: Probability-adaptive narrative branching
description: Generating distinct token branches until a cumulative probability threshold is reached, adapting branching to the model's next-token distribution.

name: Human agency in AI-assisted writing
description: How interface affordances for editing, synthesis, notes, and narrative restructuring affect active human contribution and perceived ownership.

name: Chain-of-thought perturbation tests
description: Truncation, mistake insertion, filler replacement, and prefix paraphrasing used to investigate answer dependence and possible reasoning-faithfulness failures.

name: Class selectivity regularization
description: A differentiable training penalty or reward on layer-averaged unit class selectivity, used to manipulate selectivity and evaluate resulting classification performance.

name: In-context entity tracking
description: Maintaining and retrieving associations between entities and their properties from a language-model context.

name: Cross-Model Activation Patching (CMAP)
description: Replacing component activations in one model with corresponding activations from another model processing the same input.

name: Desiderata-based Component Masking (DCM)
description: Learning sparse component masks using counterfactual input pairs and desired intervention outputs to localize semantic functionality.

name: Machine unlearning
description: Removing or suppressing selected knowledge or capabilities while retaining unrelated performance.

name: WMDP-Bio
description: A 1,273-question multiple-choice benchmark of hazardous biology knowledge, used here with model-specific permutation-stable selection.

name: Representation Misdirection for Unlearning (RMU)
description: A fine-tuning baseline combining changes to forget-corpus activations with preservation of retain-corpus activations.

name: Double descent
description: Nonmonotonic test loss across dataset size or model capacity, including regions where more data or capacity worsens performance.

name: Memorization
description: Learning example-specific behavior, investigated here through finite-data reconstruction and repeated training examples.

name: Maximal data dimensionality
description: The supremum over directions v with nonzero denominator of (v·h_i)² divided by the sum of (v·h_j)² across examples, highlighting directions disproportionately associated with one example.

name: Platonic Representation Hypothesis
description: The hypothesis that sufficiently capable models trained across objectives and modalities converge toward a shared statistical representation of the reality generating their observations.

name: Mutual k-nearest-neighbor alignment
description: Average intersection of corresponding examples' nearest-neighbor index sets, divided by k; measures local neighborhood agreement.

name: Contrastive representation learning
description: Learning representations by distinguishing positive cooccurring examples from negative examples sampled from marginal distributions.

name: Pointwise mutual information representation kernel
description: A similarity function given by the logarithm of joint cooccurrence probability divided by the product of marginals; under stated conditions, an offset version admits an inner-product representation.

name: Non-linear representation dilemma
description: Expressive nonlinear alignment maps may access nonlinear encodings while making intervention agreement uninformative without justified constraints on map complexity.

name: Latent out-of-distribution detection
description: Detecting anomalous internal activations relative to trusted examples, using Gaussian, VAE, Gram-matrix, or topological methods.

name: Obfuscated Adversarial Training (OAT)
description: Training model weights so that a frozen activation monitor correctly classifies examples generated to evade it.

name: Error correction for superposed Boolean representations
description: Sparse signed re-encoding and piecewise-linear rounding intended to restore low-interference Boolean representations between computational layers.

name: Boundless Distributed Alignment Search
description: An extension of DAS that jointly learns an orthogonal activation rotation and subspace dimensions using annealed boundary masks.

name: Price Tagging
description: A synthetic instruction-following task requiring a Yes/No decision about whether a dollar amount lies between two numerical bounds.

name: Representation erasure
description: Analyze a fixed model by zeroing representation coordinates or removing input units and measuring resulting prediction changes.

name: Reinforcement learning for decision-changing word erasure
description: Learn a binary deletion policy rewarded for flipping a frozen classifier's label with few removed words, with a regularizer encouraging contiguous deletions.

name: Counterfactual explanation consistency
description: Testing whether prediction changes under controlled input perturbations agree with dependencies asserted or omitted by an explanation.

name: BIG-Bench Hard
description: The benchmark supplying the thirteen selected tasks used for answer-bias experiments.

name: Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ)
description: A social-stereotype question-answering benchmark, modified here with exchanged weak evidence to evaluate explanation consistency.

name: Attribution-based Parameter Decomposition (APD)
description: Learns additive parameter components using parameter reconstruction, attribution-selected sparse forward passes, and a low-rank simplicity penalty.

name: Mechanistic description length
description: A proposed coding objective combining the number of components used per input with the total ranks of their constituent weight matrices.

name: Parameter linearity
description: The assumption that mechanisms combine additively in parameter space and that inactive mechanisms can be partially ablated in arbitrary combinations without materially changing outputs.

name: Cross-layer distributed mechanisms
description: Mechanisms whose constituent parameter contributions span multiple architectural layers; cross-layer distribution need not itself establish superposition.

name: Negative-bias monosemanticity training
description: Initializing hidden biases negatively and temporarily decaying them toward zero to encourage feature-specialized neurons through training path dependence.

name: Isolated-feature response monosemanticity
description: A neuron's strongest isolated-feature response divided by its summed positive isolated-feature responses, with a small denominator stabilizer. The threshold is 0.999; absolute-value experiments first combine responses to positive and negative versions of each feature.

name: Stochastic Parameter Decomposition (SPD)
description: Learns rank-one parameter subcomponents and input-dependent importance functions by preserving outputs under stochastic partial ablations while penalizing importance.

name: Gradient-based in-context learning
description: Forward-pass computation implementing gradient-based updates on an implicit objective constructed from context examples.

name: Linear self-attention
description: Attention aggregating values with unnormalized query–key dot products instead of softmax weights.

name: Curvature-corrected in-context gradient descent
description: GD++ combines gradient-induced target updates with context-dependent input transformations x ← (I−γXXᵀ)x.

name: SAE error decomposition
description: Decomposition of reconstruction error into an affine prediction from original activations and a residual termed nonlinear error.

name: Mixed dense and sparse activation model
description: A proposed activation model combining a sparse sum of linear features with a remaining dense component.

name: Extensional and intensional equivalence
description: The distinction between computing the same input-output function on a specified domain and implementing that function through the same mechanism.

name: Variable binding
description: Associating variables with values and retrieving those values for subsequent computation.

name: Cross-model SAE transfer
description: Applying or adapting an SAE trained on one model to activations from a related model.

name: Monosemanticity assumption
description: The assumption that atomic representational variables have single human-interpretable meanings, potentially understandable in isolation.

name: Tacit representations
description: Knowledge embodied in procedures or behavioral dispositions without a corresponding explicit representation of each rule, proposition, reason, or aggregate objective.

name: Minimum description length SAE selection
description: Selecting sparse autoencoders by the bit cost of their codes and decoder subject to a reconstruction or downstream-loss tolerance.

name: Independent additivity of feature explanations
description: The proposed requirement that explanations of feature combinations compose from independently understandable feature explanations.

name: Hierarchical feature coding
description: Coding child-feature activations conditionally on parent activation to exploit known feature hierarchies.

name: AutoCircuit
description: A released Python library implementing efficient edge patching, multiple ablation values, and circuit discovery algorithms for TransformerLens models.

name: Functional modularity of weight subnetworks
description: Task-defined organization of network weights, distinguishing specialization for different functions from reuse across instances of the same function.

name: Differentiable binary weight masking
description: Learning binary masks over individual network weights using continuous gradient estimators, usually while freezing the underlying weights.

name: Systematic generalization
description: Generalizing to unseen combinations of familiar operations or concepts governed by previously encountered rules.

name: Functional module reuse
description: Using the same parameter subnetwork for repeated instances of a function despite differences in input sources or output destinations.

name: SCAN
description: Command-to-action sequence benchmark with IID, length, and held-out primitive-combination splits.

name: Sparse mixtures of linear transforms (MOLTs)
description: MLP replacements that sum sparsely gated, low-rank linear transformations of residual-stream inputs.

name: Privileged residual-stream basis
description: Residual-stream coordinates exhibit activation statistics that differ systematically from those in random orthonormal bases.

name: Coordinatewise adaptive optimization
description: Optimizer updates such as Adam normalize gradients separately in stored parameter coordinates, potentially breaking rotational symmetry.

name: Activation coordinate kurtosis
description: Within-token kurtosis across activation coordinates, averaged over tokens and compared with randomly rotated representations.

name: Concept Ablation Fine-Tuning (CAFT)
description: Fine-tuning through projections that remove selected undesired activation directions, then removing the projection hooks for inference.

name: Class-conditioned unit ablation
description: Evaluating unit removal through per-class accuracy changes, including maximum class damage and class-targeted greedy removal.

name: Weight superposition
description: Sharing of parameter capacity between feature-level connections when features occupy a lower-dimensional activation space.

name: Gradient Sparse Autoencoders (g-SAEs)
description: TopK sparse autoencoders that select latents using preactivation values and decoder-projected downstream predictive-loss gradients.

name: Maximum-entropy characterization of causal scrubbing
description: Characterizing scrubbed treeified inputs as the maximum-entropy distribution preserving interpretation-node joint input marginals.

name: Adversarial hypothesis validation
description: Searching for additional preserved structure that substantially changes a hypothesis's predicted metric.

name: Multimodal Automated Interpretability Agent (MAIA)
description: A GPT-4V agent that composes tools into iterative experiments to describe visual neurons and investigate classifier behavior.

name: Synthetic vision neurons
description: An 85-neuron benchmark using Grounded DINO and SAM to implement text-specified single-concept, disjunctive, and conditional response profiles.

name: Spawrious
description: A synthetic dog-breed classification benchmark with controlled breed-background correlations and shifted test pairings.

name: Skip transcoders
description: Transcoders augmented with a learned affine input-to-output path intended to model linear MLP behavior separately from sparse latent contributions.

name: Soft interventions
description: Replacement of structural equations by possibly nonconstant functions with unchanged domains, codomains, and permitted parents.

name: Soft causal abstraction
description: Abstraction requiring soft-restriction correspondence and consistency of intervened structural functions over every endogenous and exogenous setting.

name: Text convolutional filters
description: Learned filters scoring concatenated word embeddings in local text windows.

name: Global max-pooling
description: Selecting each filter's largest response across all input positions before classification.

name: Slot activation analysis
description: Decomposing a text filter's score into word-position contributions, then inspecting, clustering, and contrasting their activation patterns.

name: Sensitive direction analysis
description: Comparing downstream responses to unit activation-space directions over controlled perturbation lengths.

name: Cov-random mixture baseline
description: A perturbation direction formed from two covariance-adjusted random activations without using the activation being perturbed.

name: SAE-Targeted Steering (SAE-TS)
description: Constructing steering directions from an affine predictor of rollout SAE effects, using a target-effect column and a bias-related correction.

name: Rollout SAE feature effects
description: Differences in mean SAE activations obtained by replaying text generated under steered and unsteered conditions.

name: EffectVis
description: An interactive interface for exploring feature effects, incoming feature actions, and decoder-cosine neighbors; comparative user benefits are not rigorously evaluated.

name: SAE effect rotation steering
description: An SVD-derived orthogonal transformation of SAE decoder directions, followed by bias correction, proposed to extend targeting beyond the measurement dictionary.

name: Goal misgeneralization
description: Competent pursuit of an unintended goal outside the training distribution despite a reward specification intended to favor another goal.

name: Goal representations in policy networks
description: Internal representations associated with a policy's targets or competing behavioral objectives.

name: Procgen Maze
description: Procedurally generated maze navigation with a cheese target, used here to investigate reward-location shifts and policy control.

name: Reasoning behavior steering
description: Activation steering targeting backtracking, expressed uncertainty, example testing, and recalled-knowledge addition in generated reasoning.

name: Reasoning behavior annotation
description: Segmenting generated reasoning into initialization, deduction, knowledge addition, example testing, uncertainty expression, and backtracking.

name: Summit
description: A browser-based system for exploring class-level CNN activation and influence summaries through attribution graphs and linked class views.

name: Class-level activation and influence aggregation
description: Counts prominent channel activations and inter-channel convolutional contributions across images of a class, then combines these statistics for graph extraction.

name: SAE feature geometry
description: Local, intermediate, and global geometric organization of sparse-autoencoder decoder vectors.

name: Semantic crystal structure
description: Approximate parallelograms or trapezoids formed by representations whose differences correspond to related semantic transformations.

name: SAE co-occurrence lobes
description: Groups of SAE features identified from within-document co-occurrence and assessed for geometric localization.

name: BertViz
description: Interactive attention visualization with head, model, and query–key neuron views, adapted to GPT-2 and BERT.

name: First-token attention
description: Attention concentrated on the first sentence token, interpreted here as a default or null target without requiring a dedicated special token.

name: Attention variability
description: Normalized mean absolute deviation from position-specific mean attention, introduced to distinguish content-sensitive from position-based attention.

name: Label-word anchors
description: Contextualized demonstration label-token representations proposed to aggregate demonstration information and supply references for classification.

name: Anchor re-weighting
description: Learning head- and layer-specific post-softmax multipliers on attention from the prediction position to demonstration label tokens.

name: Anchor-state context compression
description: Replacing full demonstrations with cached layerwise hidden states of label and formatting tokens.

name: Capability wrappers
description: Localized transformations that redirect or suppress an existing capability while leaving it recoverable.

name: Reverse fine-tuning
description: Further training toward an original pretraining task to assess recovery speed relative to alternative training histories.

name: Behavioral self-awareness
description: Accurately describing learned behavioral policies without in-context behavioral demonstrations or explicit policy-description training.

name: Out-of-context reasoning
description: Inferring and articulating conclusions implicit in training data without in-context examples or chain-of-thought reasoning.

name: Reversal curse
description: Failure to generalize a learned directional association to its reverse; proposed here as an explanation for failures of behavior-to-trigger elicitation.

name: Reversal training
description: Augmenting examples with reversed user–assistant content so that behavior precedes a trigger-containing prompt in some training examples.

name: CLIP-Dissect
description: Training-free neuron labeling by matching activation profiles over unlabeled images to pretrained vision-language concept scores.

name: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)
description: A pretrained image–text embedding model supplying scores for candidate neuron descriptions.

name: Momentum-based attention
description: Standard attention augmented with an exponentially decayed sum of preceding attention value vectors, motivated by gradient descent with momentum.

name: Intruder sentence detection
description: An explanation-free task identifying a non-activating context among four contexts activating the same latent, with a variant using an intruder from another activation decile.

name: Example embedding scoring
description: An explanation-free latent score using sentence-embedding similarity contrasts between example sets and activating or non-activating queries.

name: Arithmetic reasoning
description: Internal computations used to answer questions involving numerical operands and arithmetic operators.

name: Semantic image editing through unit manipulation
description: Edits generated scenes by spatially activating or suppressing unit groups associated with object concepts.

name: Neuron to Graph (N2G)
description: An automated procedure that converts activating examples into token-pattern tries for neuron activation prediction, visualization, search, and comparison.

name: Agent–device mixture agency
description: Relative agency classification by comparing trajectory likelihoods under mixtures of reward-directed policies and device policies.

name: Actor–critic proxy inconsistency
description: A policy's out-of-distribution behavior can pursue a different proxy from the states favored by its jointly trained critic.

name: Encoder-decoder feature interventions
description: Encode activations into interpretable coordinates, edit selected coordinates, and decode them into replacement activations; vocabulary lenses use pseudoinverse decoders.

name: Bounded Dyck language modeling
description: Balanced-bracket sequence modeling with controlled bracket types and nesting depth, supporting structural and depth generalization tests.

name: Attention embedding centroid replacement
description: Separately clustering keys and queries with k-means and replacing each embedding with its nearest centroid before computing attention.

name: Compositional factual reasoning
description: Combining constituent factual relations to answer multi-hop questions, including computing and using an unspoken intermediate entity.

name: Correcting Compositional Reasoning via Model Editing (CREME)
description: Editing attention output projections using compositional-query inputs and corresponding second-hop-reference outputs, with covariance-weighted preservation of existing mappings.

name: MQuAKE
description: A multi-hop factual-question benchmark used here to construct reasoning analyses and selected editing evaluations.

name: Distribution shift
description: Differences between conditions represented in training experience and those encountered during evaluation or deployment.

name: Agent-induced distribution shift
description: Changes in encountered conditions caused by an agent's behavior, such as eliminating threats or depleting renewable resources.

name: Specification gaming
description: Undesirable behavior resulting from optimizing a flawed designer-provided scoring function.

name: Gradient Sparse Autoencoder influence scoring (GradSAE)
description: Training-free ranking of existing SAE latents by sequence-averaged output-gradient-times-activation scores, restricting selection to positive scores.

name: SAE output-score selection
description: Filtering candidate SAE features using the rank-weighted probability of their representative logit-lens tokens after amplification on a neutral prompt.

name: Input-aligned SAE features
description: SAE features whose maximally activating input tokens overlap strongly with their decoder direction’s top logit-lens tokens.

name: MLP activation neuron circuits
description: Circuits traced over hidden MLP activations before the down projection, treating different token positions as distinct nodes.

name: Local Loss Landscape Decomposition (L3D)
description: Learning low-rank parameter directions that sparsely reconstruct gradients of divergence between paired model outputs.

name: Loss-landscape degeneracy
description: Parameter configurations or directions preserving loss, with additional input-subset-specific degeneracies hypothesized to enable sparse computational decompositions.

name: Pando
description: A model-organism benchmark for recovering parameter-trained decision rules under controlled explanation faithfulness and query budgets.

name: Elicitation confounder
description: Apparent white-box interpretability benefits can reflect differences in black-box elicitation when target information is already recoverable through prompting.

name: Quirk Expression Rate matching
description: Tuning organism training to approximately equalize judged target-reaction frequency on fixed trigger prompts, supplemented by leakage and black-box checks.

name: Integrated model organism training
description: Embedding quirk-relevant preferences into a broad DPO training phase rather than adding a separate narrow fine-tune.

name: Matching Pursuit sparse autoencoders
description: SAEs whose codes are constructed by sequentially selecting decoder directions and subtracting their projections from the residual.

name: Gradient Interaction Modifications (GIM)
description: Attribution backpropagation combining temperature-adjusted attention softmax gradients, frozen normalization factors, and normalization of gradients through multiplicative operations.

name: Attention self-repair
description: Softmax redistribution compensates for suppressing an attention score when other attended positions have similar downstream contributions.

name: Temperature-adjusted Softmax Gradients (TSG)
description: Recomputing attention softmax at elevated temperature during backpropagation to approximate joint attention-score perturbation effects.

name: Layernorm Freeze
description: Treating cached normalization factors as constants during backpropagation to exclude compensatory normalization rescaling.

name: Multiplicative gradient normalization
description: Dividing backpropagated gradients by the number of multiplicative inputs as an approximate allocation rule.

name: Compressed sensing
description: Recovery of sparse signals from underdetermined linear measurements under suitable measurement geometry and recovery conditions.

name: Concept Synthesis (CoSy)
description: Evaluation of textual neuron explanations through explanation-conditioned image synthesis and activation comparisons with natural controls.

name: MILAN
description: Neuron-description method using learned caption and language models to produce descriptions with high weighted pointwise mutual information.

name: Labeling Neural Representations with Inverse Recognition (INVERT)
description: Neuron-description method selecting concepts or logical concept compositions by activation-based AUC on labeled examples.

name: FALCON
description: Interpretation method retrieving captions using CLIP similarity to highly activating image regions and contrasting them with low-activation examples.

name: Sycophantic agreement
description: Agreement with an objectively false user claim, distinguished from genuine agreement with a correct claim.

name: Sycophantic praise
description: Exaggerated user-directed praise, instantiated using deliberately excessive praise and professor personas in synthetic tasks.

name: Scale Sparse Autoencoders
description: Mixture-of-experts SAEs combining multiple-expert routing, global TopK feature selection, and learnable scaling of encoder mean deviations.

name: Multiple-expert routing with global TopK
description: Select several experts per input, retain the globally strongest feature activations across selected experts, and combine expert reconstructions using routing probabilities.

name: Encoder mean-deviation scaling
description: Rescale each expert encoder's deviations from its mean feature vector by a learned factor while retaining the mean component.

name: Entropy neurons
description: Selected neurons whose high-norm output directions and weak direct vocabulary projections permit modulation of next-token entropy through final LayerNorm scaling.

name: Attention deactivation neurons
description: MLP neurons that influence a downstream head's BOS allocation and output norm.

name: SAE amortisation gap
description: The discrepancy between sparse inference obtainable with a constrained learned encoder and that obtainable with more expressive inference procedures.

name: Multilayer sparse encoders
description: Multilayer neural encoders that infer sparse coefficients while retaining a linear reconstruction dictionary.

name: TokenChange feature descriptions
description: Generate feature descriptions from tokens whose logits change most, averaged across contexts, when a feature is clamped.

name: Steering attribution specificity audits
description: Audits separating steering efficacy from concept-specific attribution through functional-budget matching, multiple comparator families, protected-tail tests, polarity controls, transfer, and semantic evaluation.

name: Target alignment retained by steering nulls
description: Construction-matched randomized steering directions can retain alignment with the observed direction, limiting geometric discriminability without necessarily invalidating conditional randomization inference.

name: Polarity-mirrored steering evaluation
description: Evaluating the same steering direction on wrong-user and correct-user versions of a fact to distinguish correction from indiscriminate opposition to the user.

name: Base-10 Fourier number features
description: Sinusoidal numerical representations with periods such as 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100, examined through probes, interventions, and neuron output geometry.

name: Expert-level interpretability
description: Interpreting an entire routed expert through its activation contexts and output contributions.

name: Expert specialization
description: Differences among experts in routed contexts and promoted outputs, including morphological, syntactic, semantic, and formatting roles.

name: Vocabulary-cluster specialization scoring
description: Jensen–Shannon divergence of expert input-token or promoted-token distributions over unembedding clusters from the equal-expert layer average, corrected by a sample-size-matched random baseline.

name: Fictitious information retraction
description: Explicitly retracting false information in an assistant prefill before returning to factual content; contrasted with silently ignoring the false attribute.

name: Reentrant steering
description: Training a later-layer steering vector to match output distributions induced by an earlier, more invasive intervention on a single example.

name: Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization (NPEFF)
description: Factorization of per-example Fisher matrices into nonnegative mixtures of shared rank-one positive-semidefinite components, including the predicted-gradient variant G-NPEFF.

name: Per-example Fisher information
description: The model-distribution expectation of parameter score outer products for one input, describing local predictive-distribution sensitivity to parameter perturbations.

name: Polygenic model behaviors
description: Predictions influenced by multiple behavioral factors, potentially affecting different output classes, rather than one factor per example.

name: NNsight
description: A PyTorch-based interface that traces internal-model experiments into deferred intervention graphs for local or remote execution.

name: National Deep Inference Fabric (NDIF)
description: Shared inference infrastructure that executes intervention graphs on preloaded models, including models distributed across GPU shards.

name: Structured model access
description: Hosted interfaces permitting inspection and intervention on model internals while the provider manages deployment and access.

name: Intervention graphs
description: Serializable computation graphs representing experimental operations connected to model execution through getters and setters.

name: Token energy
description: A latent's mean squared cosine alignment with output-token embeddings, normalized by mean squared alignment among output-token embeddings; the paper also reports its root mean squared form.

name: Role Learning Networks (ROLE)
description: An analysis model that learns context-dependent filler–role assignments and an affine tensor-product approximation to a frozen encoder's representations.

name: Best-of-k description selection
description: Sampling diverse candidate feature descriptions and selecting the candidate with the highest activation-simulation score.

name: Bi-directional Preference Optimization (BiPO)
description: Learning an activation steering vector with a DPO-style objective that trains positive and negative interventions against opposing response preferences.

name: ORION structured retrieval tasks
description: Retrieval datasets with shared context–request annotations, interchangeable requests, unambiguous single-token answers, and automated dataset checks.

name: Request-patching
description: Replacing a final-position intermediate residual state to transfer a source prompt's request into a target prompt's context.

name: Linear mode connectivity
description: Low-loss or low-error interpolation between model parameter vectors, optionally after correcting neuron permutations.

name: Model stitching
description: Combining an early network segment with another network's later segment through a connector; identity stitching uses no learned connector.

name: Pizza algorithm
description: A modular-addition mechanism that adds circular operand embeddings and applies piecewise-linear transformations, producing approximate distance-modulated sum logits.

name: Algorithmic phase space
description: Variation in learned algorithms across architectures, hyperparameters, and initialization seeds, including transitions without changes in validation accuracy.

name: Circle isolation
description: Restricting a learned embedding matrix to selected principal-component pairs to examine circular computational components.

name: mParaRel
description: Multilingual factual-query templates and Wikidata triplets, modified here with object aliases, trivial-answer filtering, and cross-language coverage restrictions.

name: Refusal Direction Optimization (RDO)
description: Gradient optimization of activation directions using refusal induction, harmful-answer recovery, and benign-output retention objectives; includes the cone optimization extension.

name: Refusal concept cones
description: Polyhedral cones generated by orthonormal directions whose nonnegative combinations are optimized and sampled to assess refusal control.

name: Representational Independence (RepInd)
description: An intervention-relative criterion requiring mutual preservation of activation cosine readouts under repeated directional ablation across specified layers.

name: Gradient Slingshots
description: Fine-tuning attack that shapes synthetic-input gradients or activations toward a chosen visualization while penalizing activation changes on natural inputs.

name: Persistent character as a latent behavioral variable
description: The hypothesis that training acquires persistent internal dispositions whose expression can be activated or suppressed by context.

name: Persona-aligned prompting
description: Prompt framing designed to elicit a learned behavioral disposition, evaluated here as a jailbreak mechanism.

name: Automated persona modulation
description: Using an LLM assistant to generate misuse instructions, personas, and persona-adoption prompts for black-box jailbreaks.

name: Effective neuron sparsity
description: The number of neurons retained by incoming-weight-magnitude pruning to preserve network behavior on a specified input support; the paper's written definition requires exact function equality.

name: Selective neuron norm growth
description: Rapid norm growth in a small neuron subset while other neurons shrink, potentially concentrating control of network predictions.

name: Sparse parity
description: A synthetic task predicting the product of a hidden small subset of coordinates in a binary input vector.

name: Satisficing steering optimization
description: Optimizing a steering vector to match a prescribed target-sequence log probability rather than maximizing that probability.

name: Localized Othello heuristics
description: The hypothesis that Othello board reconstruction and move prediction predominantly aggregate imperfect rules tied to particular board locations.

name: Board pattern neurons
description: Neurons whose thresholded activations classify unions of board configurations sufficient to make one specified move legal.

name: Clock neurons
description: Neurons whose activations depend strongly on move number or game phase, with hypothesized roles in phase-dependent move likelihoods.

name: ProxPulse
description: A fine-tuning attack that raises low channel activations near target images while approximately preserving original model outputs through distillation.

name: CircuitBreaker visual-circuit attack
description: A vision-model attack combining ProxPulse with kernel-attribution ranking manipulation to change extracted visual circuits while encouraging head-visualization and classification-performance preservation.

name: Shared emergent-misalignment parameter subspaces
description: Cross-task alignment of low-dimensional weight-update subspaces associated with emergent misalignment.

name: Cross-task weight–activation linearity
description: Approximate agreement between activations obtained by interpolating model weights and activations obtained by interpolating endpoint representations.

name: Mechanistic anomaly detection
description: Assessing whether model behavior on an input arises through mechanisms different from those explaining reference-distribution behavior.

name: Probabilistic heuristic explanations
description: Defeasible explanations of prediction regularities in terms of model computation and an input distribution, without requiring a complete proof of the regularity.

name: Sub-explanation attribution
description: Attributing an individual effect to structured subsets of a distribution-level explanation, including minimization over subsets explaining most reference behavior.

name: Statistical–causal interpretability
description: Interpretability as estimating surrogate explanations for an explicit distribution of observational, interventional, or counterfactual queries.

name: Identifiability of interpretability tasks
description: Whether a specified query distribution, explanation class, and discrepancy determine a unique population-risk-minimizing explanation up to acceptable symmetries.

name: Uncertainty quantification for interpretability
description: Confidence sets or posterior distributions over explanations, accounting for finite computational traces and unresolved explanatory alternatives.

name: Emotion circuit modulation
description: Selecting emotion-associated neurons and heads across layers and adding matched emotion activation differences to their channels.

name: Scenario–Event with Valence (SEV)
description: A synthetic English dataset of 480 scenario–event descriptions spanning eight domains and three outcome valences, used to discover emotion-associated components.

name: LLM-Emotion corpus
description: Released English Reddit-style corpus combining natural, rewritten, and synthetic utterances labeled by Qwen3-32B with six Ekman emotions or neutral.

name: Offset-aware emotion probing
description: Prediction of the original user's emotion from a generated-token hidden state together with a learned token-offset embedding.

name: Learned emotion-subspace steering
description: Emotion-specific GELU modules compute residual activation shifts within an SVD subspace under emotion-token and hidden-state consistency objectives.

name: Additive motif
description: Qualitatively different component outputs promote the correct answer and combine constructively, even when individual contributions do not identify it.

name: Direct logit attribution by source token
description: Splitting an attention head's direct vocabulary contribution according to source positions in its weighted value sum.

name: Personality recognition with LLMs
description: Using LLMs directly, or as providers of augmented inputs and features, to infer people's personality traits from text and interaction records.

name: Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP)
description: Position-specific edge attribution, including attention-mediated cross-position connections, using recomputed local attention outputs and downstream gradient approximations.

name: Dataset schemas for circuit discovery
description: Ordered semantic or syntactic token spans that align variable-length examples into a shared abstract computation graph.

name: Attention knockout
description: Masking selected attention logits across heads and layer windows to investigate information propagation between token positions.

name: Subject attributes rate
description: Fraction of projected vocabulary tokens appearing in a filtered token set retrieved from subject-related Wikipedia paragraphs.

name: circuitry
description: A TransformerLens wrapper for specifying circuits, applying ablation strategies, and evaluating circuit behavior.

name: Concept expertise
description: The fraction of a concept inventory for which at least one native unit exceeds a specified concept-classification AP threshold.

name: SentenceConcepts
description: A OneSec-derived inventory of 1,344 sense and 297 homograph concepts represented by positive and negative sentence sets.

name: Expert-unit concept overlap
description: Representing concepts by their top-1% AP-ranked unit sets and comparing them using Jaccard overlap.

name: Cognitive appraisal theory
description: A psychological framework relating emotions to evaluations of situations, including pleasantness, agency, and predictability.

name: Appraisal concept steering
description: Activation additions derived from appraisal regression weights and projected away from protected appraisal directions to alter inferred emotion labels.

name: crowd-enVENT
description: Human-written emotional-event vignettes with self-reported emotions and appraisal ratings, used for emotion inference and representation analysis.

name: Personality trait prompting
description: Shaping expressed Big Five traits through adjective lists and linguistic intensity qualifiers, independently or concurrently.

name: Construct validity assessment
description: Evaluating whether operational measurements capture intended constructs through convergent, discriminant, criterion, and structural analyses, alongside reliability checks.

name: Apply Magic Sauce
description: A human-trained psychodemographic API used to estimate Big Five personality from generated social media text.

name: PsySET
description: A benchmark combining emotion and personality steering effectiveness, intensity control, output quality, and downstream trustworthiness evaluations.

name: Sparse Readout Prism (SRP)
description: Sparse dictionary factorization of unembedding rows that expresses selected readout scores as feature contributions with explicit offset and residual terms.

name: Readout features
description: Shared dictionary directions in an LM head, with sparse token-row coefficients and state-dependent contributions to selected scores.

name: Fitted-lens corpus conditionality
description: Dependence of fitted-lens token readings on the corpus used to estimate the transport, even when the underlying hidden state is fixed.

name: Attention-causal communication
description: Tracing projected upstream contributions whose removal changes a selected attention decision.

name: ACC++
description: Prompt-specific tracing using component–singular-direction candidates, softmax Integrated Gradients, and greedy attention-threshold counterfactuals.

name: RL-Obfuscation
description: Reinforcement-learning stress testing that jointly rewards monitor evasion and target-response quality without differentiating through the monitor.

name: Scalable Oversight via Lie Detector (SOLiD)
description: Using a lie detector to route responses to expensive reviewers and construct preference-training labels; SOLiD-Defer instead directly penalizes flagged responses.

name: DolusChat
description: A 65,000-example synthetic chat dataset containing contextual information, user queries, and paired truthful/deceptive responses.

name: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
description: On-policy optimization using groups of sampled responses, group-normalized advantages, learned rewards, and reference-policy KL regularization.

name: Compressed Computation
description: The restricted-width coordinatewise ReLU toy task introduced by Braun et al., examined here through a reduced formulation with feature-mixed targets.

name: Feature-mixed ReLU targets
description: Targets of the form ReLU(x) + Mx, where a fixed matrix mixes input coordinates into the labels; the mixing is deterministic conditional on the input and matrix.

name: Semi-nonnegative matrix factorization
description: Matrix factorization with one nonnegative factor, used here to construct ReLU MLP weights from a mixing-related matrix.

name: Semantic compositionality
description: How neural models combine word and phrase meanings, including negation, intensification, and clause composition.

name: Sentence-mean embedding deviation saliency
description: A word-importance visualization using each embedding coordinate's squared deviation from the corresponding sentence-average coordinate.

name: Binding problem
description: The challenge of dynamically grouping, separating, and relating distributed neural information into coherent entities and structures.

name: Object-centric representations
description: Separate, reusable entity representations with distributed internal features and a common interface; entities may be perceptual or abstract.

name: Perceptual segregation
description: Formation of grounded, context-dependent object representations from initially unstructured sensory information.

name: Slot-based representations
description: Separate representational containers for entities, including instance, sequential, spatial, and category slots.

name: Attractor dynamics
description: Representational dynamics with stable states that can support correction of perturbations and distinct coherent interpretations of ambiguous inputs.

name: Machine Personality Inventory (MPI)
description: A 120-item and approximately 1,000-item multiple-choice assessment of Big Five tendencies, scored using trait means and within-trait item-score deviations.

name: PrOntoQA
description: Synthetic ontology-based reasoning benchmark with true, false, and fictional relationships; this study modifies its language and constrains the reasoning template.

name: Context-abidance score
description: The fraction of positions where a head-output vocabulary argmax forms a bigram with the position's input token that occurs in the supplied context.

name: Refined local learning coefficient
description: Component- and distribution-specific refinements of the LLC, estimated by restricting parameter perturbations and changing the data used for posterior sampling and loss evaluation.

name: Local learning coefficient
description: A singular-learning-theory measure of local population-loss geometry, defined through the asymptotic scaling of near-minimal-loss parameter volume.

name: Developmental interpretability
description: Understanding neural computations by tracking the emergence, differentiation, and reorganization of internal structures throughout training.

name: Multigram circuits
description: Coordinating attention-head pathways for predicting contiguous and noncontiguous token patterns, including nested delimiter patterns.

name: Interpretability circumvention
description: Passive or deliberate processes that prevent interpretability methods from revealing safety-relevant computation; analyzed through a proposed cognitosecurity perspective.

name: Interpretability as information flow
description: A threat-analysis framework following exposure, perception, recognition, and output through interpretation tools and human interpreters.

name: Gradient hacking
description: An agent's deliberate influence over its learning updates to preserve or alter its future computation.

name: Externalized cognition
description: Use of environmental states as memory or computational variables, including autostigmergy and proposed agent–environment reservoir computation.

name: Diversity hypothesis for interpretability
description: The hypothesis that interpretable features tend to arise at an abstraction level if and only if training is sufficiently diverse at that level; the sufficiency direction additionally requires task relevance and is intended as a practical tendency.

name: CoinRun
description: A procedurally generated platformer used here to study visual features, agent failures, and generalization across level layouts.

name: Spatially aware dataset feature visualization
description: Selecting strongly activating observation patches separately at each spatial position to expose position-dependent feature responses.

name: Weight-graph clusterability
description: Structural modularity measured by clustering an undirected neural-network graph with absolute connection weights and evaluating normalized cut.

name: Normalized spectral clustering
description: Partitioning a weighted graph using low-eigenvalue normalized-Laplacian eigenvectors followed by k-means.

name: Dropout
description: Training regularization that randomly zeros neuronal activations, evaluated here for its effects on weight-graph clusterability.

name: Interleaving++
description: Auxiliary safety-data interleaving selected by aligned-versus-misaligned relative answer-loss gaps, with refusal filtering.

name: Reference-policy KL regularization
description: Penalizing divergence from an aligned reference model's output distribution during adaptation.

name: LDIFS
description: Feature-preservation regularization penalizing squared activation differences from a reference model.

name: OpSwap
description: Synthetic algebraic simplification benchmark with standard or permuted arithmetic-operator meanings.

name: Steerability bias
description: Dependence of an intervention's behavioral effect on nuisance properties such as answer position or Yes/No wording, distinct from an unsteered answer preference.

name: Steerability slope
description: Least-squares slope of target-versus-alternative answer logit difference against steering multiplier, evaluated per input or in aggregate.

name: Model-Written Evaluations
description: Model-generated behavioral evaluation datasets spanning personas, preferences, and alignment-relevant tendencies.

name: Featurewise quantile calibration
description: Monotonically transform each latent's simulated activations using empirical CDFs and a true-activation reference distribution.

name: Feature hedging
description: Mixing correlated unrepresented features into represented SAE directions under insufficient dictionary capacity, reducing reconstruction error while compromising feature isolation.

name: Balance Matryoshka sparse autoencoders
description: Matryoshka SAEs with weighted prefix losses intended to balance hedging against absorption.

name: Hedging degree
description: An SAE-extension diagnostic measuring existing decoder changes projected onto the span of newly learned latents, minus projections onto a random latent span.

name: Mutual-information-based SAE explanations
description: Vocabulary-word explanations ranked using feature-to-word affinity and word-to-feature specificity derived from output-embedding dot products.

name: Frequency bias in SAE explanations
description: The proposed tendency for recurrent lexical patterns to dominate activation-example explanations and obscure broader discourse associations.

name: Sparse Autoencoder steering for Instruction Following (SAIF)
description: Ranks SAE latents by instruction-induced activation onset and combines their decoder directions using activation-statistic weights.

name: Instruction following
description: Producing responses that satisfy requested operations, content constraints, or output formats.

name: Normalization-mediated self-repair
description: Compensation caused by an ablation changing the final LayerNorm or RMSNorm denominator and thereby rescaling remaining logit contributions.

name: Self-repressing attention heads
description: Heads whose direct effects decrease when their previously computed outputs are added to their own input residual stream.

name: Self-prediction training
description: Fine-tuning a model to answer hypothetical questions about properties extracted from its separately generated object-level responses.

name: Cross-prediction evaluation of introspection
description: Comparing self-prediction with another model's prediction of the same target after comparable behavioral training.

name: Self-simulation
description: The hypothesis that a model internally simulates its hypothetical response or response distribution and then computes a requested property.

name: Feature representation biases
description: Systematic differences in feature-associated activation variance or distribution arising from complexity, learning history, prevalence, position, and training choices despite comparable output roles.

name: Feature-conditioned variance analysis
description: Regressing from known feature values or complete relevant-input pattern labels to activations and evaluating held-out explained variance.

name: Interaction Basis
description: Layerwise activation coordinates constructed through activation whitening and downstream-Jacobian second moments to remove null directions and reduce coordinate dependence.

name: Effective parameter count
description: Twice the local behavioral-loss learning coefficient at a chosen loss scale, proposed as a measure of computationally relevant parameter complexity.

name: Behavioral loss
description: A nonnegative discrepancy between a network's outputs and a fixed reference network's outputs on specified inputs, used to study behavior-preserving parameter changes.

name: Finite-loss-scale learning coefficient
description: The logarithmic derivative of low-loss parameter volume evaluated at a nonzero loss cutoff instead of taking the zero-loss limit.

name: Synchronized nonlinearities
description: Neurons sharing activation gates, or attention heads sharing attention patterns, permitting additional compensated parameter transformations.

name: Direction influence on pretraining-like text
description: Measuring a behavioral direction's influence through the output KL it induces on representative pretraining-like inputs across intervention norms.

name: Categorical concept polytopes
description: Categorical representations defined as convex hulls of magnitude-calibrated attribute vectors.

name: Hierarchical concept orthogonality
description: Orthogonality between parent representations and hierarchical increments or subordinate contrast directions in the causal metric.

name: Shrinkage-LDA concept estimation
description: Estimating feature directions using inverse within-class covariance times the class mean, with Ledoit–Wolf shrinkage and projection-based magnitude calibration.

name: WordNet concept hierarchy
description: Synset descendant word sets used to define lexical attributes and hierarchical relationships.

name: SAE L0 selection
description: Selecting an SAE's average active-latent budget to improve feature recovery and avoid resource-induced mixing.

name: Decoder pairwise cosine similarity
description: The mean absolute cosine similarity over distinct SAE decoder-column pairs, proposed as a diagnostic for shared feature mixing and L0 selection.

name: Differentiable Masking (DIFFMASK)
description: Amortized, hidden-state-conditioned stochastic masking of inputs or intermediate token states, optimized for sparsity while approximately preserving a frozen model's outputs.

name: Hindsight bias in erasure
description: Mistaking a prediction-preserving reduced input for an account of the information used when processing the complete input.

name: Singular Learning Theory
description: A theory relating Bayesian learning, accuracy–complexity tradeoffs, and phase structure to the geometry of singular statistical models.

name: Residual-stream clean-up
