description: Downstream components write opposing contributions that reduce directions written by earlier components; subsequent reuse of the space is a separate question.

name: Direct Logit Attribution
description: Attribution of token logits or logit differences to additive component outputs through the final vocabulary readout, accounting for normalization.

name: Directional agreement of activation differences
description: Cosine agreement of contrastive activation differences with their mean direction, used as a diagnostic of CAA reliability.

name: Non-transitivity of counterfactual dependence
description: Local counterfactual dependencies along a computational chain need not imply a corresponding dependency between its endpoints.

name: Causal overdetermination
description: Multiple simultaneously present causes are each sufficient for an effect, potentially leaving small or zero singleton removal effects.

name: Steering specificity evaluation
description: Evaluation separating preservation of unrelated abilities, related control properties, and control properties under distribution shift.

name: Overrefusal
description: Refusal of benign requests that resemble unsafe requests.

name: Faithfulness hallucinations
description: Answers that ignore or overwrite supplied contextual information, particularly when context conflicts with pretrained knowledge.

name: Partial orthogonalization
description: Adjustment of a target direction relative to a control direction, followed by directional ablation to mitigate false refusal.

name: Logit spectroscopy
description: Analysis and filtering of residual signals and component weights using spectral bands of vocabulary embedding and unembedding matrices.

name: Dark residual signals
description: Residual components in the bottom 5% right-singular-vector subspaces of embedding or unembedding matrices, termed E-dark or U-dark respectively.

name: Attention sinks
description: Tokens, especially BoS, that attract disproportionate attention and are interpreted as absorbing otherwise unused attention mass.

name: Attention bars
description: Non-BoS tokens receiving sustained attention from many subsequent tokens, producing bright columns in attention matrices.

name: Activation source selection
description: Choosing the eliciting context and activation readout policy used to construct a steering signal.

name: Execution-boundary states
description: Hidden states read immediately before a continuation intended to realize or sustain a target behavior, contrasted with states after target realization.

name: Tail subtraction
description: Constructing steering sources by subtracting a matched local question-and-prefix activation from a target-conditioned boundary activation.

name: Low-rank communication channels
description: Low-dimensional residual-stream subspaces through which upstream attention heads write signals read by downstream heads.

name: SVD component composition analysis
description: Decomposing attention weight products into rank-one singular components and scoring their composition with other head matrices to identify candidate communication pathways.

name: Laundry List retrieval
description: Synthetic missing-item retrieval from an initial object list and a shuffled second list containing all but one item.

name: Steer-to-Target-Projection (StTP)
description: For tokens below a classifier-derived boundary, replace the projection along a steering direction with a positive-class mean plus a scaled positive-class standard deviation.

name: Steer-to-Mirror-Projection (StMP)
description: Apply a scaled reflection across a classifier-derived projection boundary only to tokens below that boundary.

name: MASK benchmark
description: Honesty evaluation distinguishing honesty from accuracy; H@1 measures the fraction of honest answers under a single lie prompt.

name: Poser
description: A paired-model benchmark for detecting deliberately trained alignment-faking policies using prompts with matching greedy outputs.

name: Activation noise injection
description: Adding random internal activation perturbations to compare behavioral sensitivity or train resistance to that sensitivity.

name: Local Interaction Basis (LIB)
description: A backward-recursive activation transformation combining whitening, adjacent-layer Jacobian singular directions, and importance scaling.

name: Singular vector–feature alignment
description: Alignment between attention QK singular vectors and feature directions involved in attention selection.

name: Sparse attention decomposition
description: Decomposition of attention logits or relative attention into QK singular-mode contributions, with concentration in a few modes used as a candidate feature diagnostic.

name: In-context task vectors
description: Hidden states extracted from demonstration prompts and substituted into demonstration-free prompts to recover task behavior.

name: Decoding by contrasting layers (DoLa)
description: A decoding procedure contrasting final-layer token probabilities with those from a premature layer selected using Jensen–Shannon divergence.

name: Spectral–geometric dissociation
description: Fourier peaks and substantial harmonic energy can coexist with poor linear decoding of numerical residue classes.

name: Structural data attribution
description: Controlled changes to data associations or accessible context used to investigate which distributional structures contribute to learned representations.

name: Universality hypothesis
description: The broader question of whether different models develop analogous features, examined here through numerical spectra and residue readouts.

name: Number tokenization
description: Segmentation of numeral strings into tokens, affecting the numerical subproblems required by addition training.

name: Entailment-based personality scoring
description: Estimating textual Big Five expression by comparing NLI entailment scores for opposing trait hypotheses and mapping the resulting probabilities to a 1–5 scale.

name: Personality-annotated fine-tuning
description: Updating a generative model using trait-selected text or an auxiliary trait-classification objective, then evaluating changes in generated personality expression.

name: Logit prisms
description: Hierarchical logit attribution through projections with normalization, attention weights, and nonlinear factors held fixed at a forward pass.

name: Belief state geometry
description: The arrangement of posterior distributions over generator states within a probability simplex, used as a target for interpreting neural representations.

name: Mixed-state presentations
description: Predictive state machines whose states are posterior distributions over hidden generator states and whose transitions implement observation-conditioned belief updates.

name: Computational mechanics
description: A theoretical framework describing stochastic processes through predictive states and sufficient statistics of the past for the future.

name: Singular-vector vocabulary projection
description: Interpret residual-space singular vectors of transformer weight matrices through their highest-scoring vocabulary tokens.

name: Singular-component weight ablation
description: Remove a selected singular component by subtracting its singular-value-weighted outer product from a weight matrix.

name: Natural-language SVD direction search
description: Locate candidate semantic weight directions by comparing encoded query tokens with singular vectors using cosine similarity.

name: RealToxicityPrompts
description: Naturally occurring text prefixes used to evaluate toxic continuation behavior.

name: Perspective API
description: Automatic toxicity scorer producing scores between zero and one.

name: Feature-preserving circuit pruning
description: Saliency-based removal of convolutional kernels without fine-tuning to approximate a target filter's responses across images or selected stimuli.

name: Circuit Explorer
description: The released circuit-pruning API and visualization tool for diagrams extending from target filters back to pixels.

name: Aggregation of Layer-Wise Token-to-Token Interactions (ALTI)
description: An attribution method whose local rule measures normalized L1 proximity of incoming vectors to their sum; this work uses that rule without ALTI's full-model propagation.

name: Subword merging heads
description: Heads that gather earlier subwords of the same word at later subwords while contributing little at first subwords.

name: Binding ID mechanism
description: A proposed mechanism linking separately represented entities and attributes through corresponding abstract identifiers, implemented approximately by paired additive activation vectors.

name: Direct entity–attribute binding
description: Representing an associated pair together at a contextual site rather than linking separate value representations through abstract binding IDs.

name: LLM-Insight
description: A multilingual collection of target words, sentences, and open-ended prompts designed for representation analysis and steering evaluation.

name: Local specialization
description: Localization of comprehensible, task-relevant subtasks within groups of neurons.

name: Neuron-group coherence
description: Assessment of whether grouped neurons associate with related input features, operationalized through joint activation maximization and class-conditioned measurements.

name: Query circuits
description: Prompt-specific attention-head and MLP edge subgraphs discovered directly within the original language model.

name: Normalized Deviation Faithfulness (NDF)
description: One minus clipped absolute circuit–model score deviation, normalized by the model's clean–corrupted score gap.

name: Best-of-N query circuit discovery
description: Selects the highest-NDF candidate on the original query from circuits constructed using attribution scores for that query and its variants; includes iBoN and BoN-CSM reuse methods.

name: Training-time activation clamping
description: Maintaining selected activation-level interventions throughout optimization, with appropriate gradient routing, to investigate causal dependencies in circuit formation.

name: Visual Interpretability Index
description: A visual-response coherence score computed from similarities among five highest-activating dataset images for a unit or candidate feature.

name: Activation-space clustering
description: Clustering stimulus-evoked population activations to identify centroid-associated candidate features.

name: Visual feature synergy
description: An increase in exemplar coherence when combining z-scored neuron responses, measured relative to the higher-scoring constituent.

name: Safety residual space
description: An affine pre/post-safety-training activation map analyzed through right singular vectors of its linear part minus identity.

name: Partial Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (PLRP)
description: Relevance propagation from squared activation projections onto selected directions to input tokens or earlier-layer directional coordinates.

name: Group Fourier features
description: Scalar or matrix-valued harmonics corresponding to irreducible unitary representations of a symmetry group.

name: Symmetry discovery
description: Recovering an unknown symmetry group's algebraic structure from observations or learned weights.

name: Spectral Networks
description: Complex polynomial models parameterizing power spectra, bispectra, and higher-order spectral invariants.

name: Norm-based attention analysis
description: Analyzing attention using Euclidean norms of value-and-output-transformed source vectors and their attention-weighted contributions.

name: Attention-based word alignment extraction
description: Extracting source–target word alignments from decoder cross-attention, with separate input-word and output-word timing conventions.

name: Future Lens
description: A decoding and visualization tool that anticipates future token predictions from individual hidden states, principally through transplantation into learned soft prompts.

name: Attention rollout
description: Aggregation of layerwise token interaction matrices by matrix multiplication, summing products over paths through layers.

name: Addressivity
description: Language being oriented toward an addressee, operationalized through chat-template, conversational-context, and pronoun cues.

name: Addressee recognition
description: Identifying the intended recipient of a conversational turn, evaluated here in four-participant conversations.

name: Instruction-Following Evaluation (IFEval)
description: A benchmark of prompts with automatically verifiable instructions; this paper uses selected subsets and synthetic augmentations.

name: Local input-gradient sensitivity
description: Using the norm of an input gradient of a scalar model output as a local sensitivity diagnostic.

name: Safety-update left-nullspace alignment
description: Analyzing whether MLP safety updates write outside the original weights' dominant column subspace while preferentially responding to unsafe inputs; the measured complement need not be an exact left null space.

name: Operator–operand safety testbed
description: A PCFG-based synthetic framework in which safety labels depend jointly on task operators and operand-generating grammar nodes.

name: Contextual–parametric knowledge conflict
description: Competition between factual associations supplied in a prompt and conflicting associations acquired during pretraining.

name: ChainSearch
description: A controlled six-input Countdown benchmark with explicit arithmetic state transitions and backtracking, enabling forward-reachability and final-expression labels.

name: Reasoning correctness directions
description: Activation-space directions associated with intermediate state reachability or eventual final-answer correctness.

name: Refusal transfer failure
description: Failure of textual refusal to carry over to safe structured tool-call behavior for a matched request.

name: Tool-call safety evaluation
description: Direct evaluation of generated tool selections and arguments, including forbidden-action checks and benign tool-use retention.

name: Conditioned divergence
description: The fraction of harmful requests refused in chat whose matched tool-enabled runs emit a predicate-violating call.

name: Singular vector tracing
description: Recursive tracing of upstream attention-head writes through input-specific QK singular subspaces.

name: Depth growing
description: Progressively increasing transformer depth by copying layer blocks, after which copied layers train independently.

name: Looped transformers
description: Transformers that repeatedly apply a shared block of layers within a forward pass.

name: RegBench
description: A benchmark for learning unseen regular languages from sequences of strings generated by deterministic finite automata.

name: In-weights learning
description: Learning persistent associations in model parameters, operationalized here by class-label prediction when the query class is absent from context.

name: Variable roles
description: Sajaniemi’s eleven behavioral categories for variables, defined through successive values, updates, and uses.

name: Variable-role representation and control benchmark
description: A natural-code benchmark combining matched prediction, reviewed role-changing edits, neutral renaming, and generation interventions with correctness evaluation.

name: Static variable-role contracts
description: Behavioral annotation rules over Joern Code Property Graph syntax, control flow, and data dependencies, covering all eleven variable roles through supported static patterns.

name: Consistent Sparse Dictionary Learning (ConSDL)
description: Alternating dictionary learning using per-sample nonnegative FISTA, support-constrained coefficient refitting, and co-active similarity regularization.

name: Cross-seed dictionary consistency
description: Agreement of independently trained sparse dictionaries and their coefficient patterns, assessed through matched atoms and dictionary clusters.

name: Story-paired concept-vector extraction
description: Constructing contrastive activation directions from synthetic concept–antagonist narratives sharing setups and varying language, genre, and generator.

name: Feature Stories
description: A released corpus of 2,072,000 synthetic narratives covering 1,036 alignment-relevant concept–antagonist pairs in five languages and ten genres.

name: Translation symmetry in word co-occurrences
description: Normalized co-occurrence relationships that depend on relative position along a semantic continuum rather than absolute position.

name: Semantic representation manifolds
description: Curves or sheets organizing representations of continuously varying semantic attributes, including calendar time, historical time, and geography.

name: Collective robustness of representation geometry
description: Preservation of semantic geometry through shared latent-variable effects distributed across many words, despite perturbations to direct target-word statistics.

name: Metric-space feature model
description: A formalization of a feature as a compact metric space, separating feature presence from its potentially continuous or multidimensional value.

name: Geodesic representation distance
description: Shortest-path distance along representation manifolds, approximated here using weighted nearest-neighbour graphs.

name: Frozen-component SAE baselines
description: Controls that freeze random encoder or decoder directions, or constrain decoder directions around initialization, while training remaining parameters.

name: Archetypal sparse autoencoders
description: SAEs whose decoder atoms are convex combinations of data representations or fixed centroids, optionally augmented with bounded additive offsets.

name: Archetypal analysis
description: Dictionary learning based on archetypes that are convex combinations of observations; classical formulations also constrain reconstruction coefficients to convex combinations.

name: Soft Identifiability Benchmark
description: Twelve synthetic object-collage datasets evaluating whether individual dictionary coordinates predict known object presence.

name: Classifier-direction plausibility
description: Mean best-atom alignment with final classifier-weight directions, proposed as an operational measure of dictionary plausibility.

name: Counterfactual Activation Potential (CAP)
description: A feature-ranking score multiplying standardized encoder alignment, standardized incoming suppression strength, and ablation-measured safety criticality.

name: CAP-guided Safety Feature Discovery (CSFD)
description: Candidate discovery through activation-mass contrasts and Cohen’s d, followed by ablation validation and CAP ranking.

name: Suppressed safety features
description: Refusal-related features receiving inhibitory influences that can reduce their activation during harmful compliance.

name: Identifiable sparse autoencoders (iSAE)
description: TopK SAE variants combining signed coefficient selection, dictionary-conditioning regularization, and optionally recurrent multistep encoding.

name: Approximate restricted isometry on observed supports
description: A distribution-relative restricted isometry condition on dictionary submatrices indexed by unions of observed sparse supports, distinct from its sampled regularization surrogate.

name: Sparse attention post-training
description: Adapting pretrained transformers with binary attention gates and an expected-edge penalty under a predictive-loss constraint.

name: Transformer Layer Correction Mechanism (TLCM)
description: Systematic opposition between adjacent transformer-block residual updates during ordinary forward passes, operationalized using update-vector cosine similarity.

name: Propose-and-reject hypothesis
description: The hypothesis that one layer proposes candidate features and the next uses context to remove inappropriate candidates.

name: Symmetrized Jacobian correction analysis
description: Eigenanalysis of the symmetric part of a residual-contribution Jacobian to characterize local response components opposing or reinforcing an input perturbation.

name: Concept-Targeted Attribution (CTA)
description: Construction of sparse feature attribution graphs targeting an internal linear-probe score instead of a next-token logit.

name: Belief-point layer selection
description: Selecting a probe-attribution layer by the largest rise in positive-class probe score, with additional accuracy-plateau conditions described in the appendix.

name: Lexical reference frames
description: Context-dependent vocabulary interfaces obtained by transporting residual states through remaining model layers with a specified order of inter-position attention.

name: Lexical readout and basis duality
description: The distinction between downstream centered-logit gradients that measure lexical sensitivity and pseudoinverse-transport directions that approximately write specified lexical targets.

name: Reward model overoptimization
description: Optimization against a learned reward proxy that eventually reduces performance on the objective used to evaluate that proxy.

name: Goodhart's law
description: Deterioration of a proxy's relationship with an intended objective under optimization, including regressional, extremal, causal, and adversarial variants.

name: Reward modeling
description: Learning scalar evaluations of responses from preference comparisons.

name: Reinforcement learning from human feedback
description: Optimizing a policy using rewards learned from human preference judgments; here investigated through a synthetic replacement of human labels.

name: Best-of-n sampling
description: Sampling multiple responses from a policy and returning the response with the highest reward-model score.

name: Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD)
description: Post-hoc sparse factorization of pretrained linear projections into scalar bottlenecks with sparse read and write connections.

name: Transcoder adapters
description: Sparse encoder–decoder modules trained alongside frozen base MLPs to approximate a fine-tuned model's changed MLP computation.

name: Hesitation-token mechanisms
description: Computations promoting hesitation words, including interactions between output-promoting adapter features and chat-template features.

name: Behavioral compositionality
description: The extent to which joint downstream effects of selected representation coordinates admit an accurate low-order description under specified interventions and behavioral readouts.

name: SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR)
description: The fraction of behavioral coalition-response variance unexplained by an optimal approximation through a chosen interaction order, estimated using held-out coalition predictions.

name: Sum-preserving coordinate rotations
description: Replacing a selected contribution matrix D by DQ, where Q is orthogonal and fixes the all-ones vector, preserving its column span and total contribution while changing subset interventions.

name: Coalition ordering evaluation
description: Comparing predicted and actual ordering of intervention subsets using Spearman correlation, behavior-weighted reversals, sign error relative to the full coalition, and selection regret.

name: Geometry-Adaptive Explainer (GAE)
description: Decoder adaptation using OOD second-moment eigenspaces, orthogonal Procrustes alignment, and optional regularized closed-form refitting with a frozen encoder.

name: Active-subspace faithfulness gap
description: Frobenius distance between equal-rank projectors onto a decoder's leading singular subspace and the leading eigenspace of OOD activation second moments.

name: Latent concept generative models
description: Models consisting of an unknown concept distribution and an unknown mixing kernel, with concept extraction defined through posterior inference.

name: Blackwell-reducible concept mixing
description: Mixing-kernel classes factoring through a common measure-separating base kernel after injective concept maps; the continuous variant underlies the proposed transition-intersection theorem.

name: Independent component analysis
description: Recovery of independent latent components from mixed observations; the application considers injective linear mixing and non-Gaussianity.

name: Circuit Tracer
description: Library for constructing, visualizing, annotating, and intervening on transcoder-based attribution graphs.

name: Imitative Generalisation
description: A proposed oversight scheme that searches human-understandable knowledge objects using imitated human prior and likelihood judgments, then learns human predictions on the target distribution.

name: Human prior imitation
description: Learning human plausibility judgments over hypotheses or annotated knowledge objects to guide generalization.

name: Microscope AI
description: Using interpreted model representations to inform human task performance rather than deploying the trained model directly.

name: Localized blur saliency
description: Spatially localized interpolation with a blurred image, scored by changes in actor logits or critic values and displayed over policy-execution videos.

name: Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA)
description: Comparison of systems through correlations between matrices of pairwise response dissimilarities.

name: Second-order stimulus confounds
description: Different stimulus features have matching inter-stimulus or inter-category relationship structures, allowing systems relying on different features to exhibit similar representational geometries.

name: Bag-of-Words Superposition (BOWS)
description: A controlled autoencoding setting using binary word-presence vectors from text, providing known input features with natural co-occurrence structure.

name: Linear superposition
description: Interfering feature representations that permit sufficiently accurate linear decoding under a specified distribution and per-feature reconstruction threshold.

name: Constructive feature interference
description: Contributions from other active features improve a target feature's reconstruction by exploiting shared statistical structure.

name: Presence coding and value coding
description: A distinction between linearly classifiable discrete properties and linearly decodable numerical values, whose projections can form structured manifolds.

name: Circuit-based Reasoning Verification (CRV)
description: Step-level reasoning-error classification using aggregate statistics of transcoder attribution graphs.

name: Shallow safety alignment
description: Safety adaptation concentrated at early response-token positions, with limited suppression of harmful continuations conditional on non-refusal prefixes.

name: Safety recovery training
description: Training refusal continuations after partial harmful responses to improve recovery from unsafe generation trajectories.

name: Tokenwise constrained fine-tuning
description: A reference-relative softplus objective with position-dependent coefficients that attenuates learning as demonstrated-token probabilities increase relative to an aligned checkpoint.

name: HEx-PHI
description: A safety benchmark containing 330 harmful instructions across 11 harmful-use categories.

name: AbsTopK sparse autoencoders
description: Sparse autoencoders retaining the largest-magnitude encoder activations while preserving their signs.

name: Proximal-unrolling SAE design
description: Interpreting SAE encoders as parameterized single proximal-gradient steps for sparse coding.

name: Bidirectional semantic features
description: Representations in which opposite coefficient signs along one feature direction correspond to contrasting semantic poles.

name: Representation redistribution
description: Changes in how activation is distributed across a fixed sparse feature dictionary under related input transformations.

name: Redistribution sensitivity score (RSS)
description: Readout-independent selection of large SAE feature changes satisfying recurrence and directional-consistency constraints, followed by evaluation with the support and directions fixed.

name: Frozen readout margin audit
description: Accounting for selected feature changes through signed contributions, remaining classification margin, readout-input restoration, and label-informed offline review.

name: Polynomial Sparse Autoencoder (PolySAE)
description: A sparse autoencoder with a conventional sparse encoder and a shared-projection, low-rank polynomial decoder containing linear, quadratic, and cubic terms.

name: Weight-sparse transformer training
description: Training transformers under an annealed nonzero-weight budget through per-matrix magnitude masking, combined here with mild activation sparsity and a separate dense bigram table.

name: Sparse–dense activation bridges
description: Learned encoders and decoders connecting sparse- and dense-model residual states, trained with reconstruction and single-transition hybrid-output objectives.

name: Programming-language defaultness
description: A code model's tendency to choose a programming language when the requested language is unspecified, distinguished from following explicit language tags.

name: Size-matched random circuit controls
description: Comparisons between extracted component sets and randomly sampled sets of equal size, with multiple-comparison correction.

name: Syntax-vocabulary probability mass
description: A next-token language-preference readout defined as target-language syntax-token probability mass minus disjoint Python syntax-token probability mass.

name: SAE activation-data requirements
description: How activation-training budgets affect reconstruction, benchmark performance, and reproducibility of individual dictionary features.

name: SAE activation-data selection
description: Selecting online activation subsets for SAE training, including uniform random selection and geometric farthest-point sampling.

name: Latent chain-of-thought
description: Additional pre-answer computation implemented by feeding continuous hidden states back as successive model inputs.

name: Latent-chain taxonomy
description: Classification of latent chains using deletion and replacement outcomes, accessible content, and state dynamics.

name: Latent-step supervision
description: Training individual latent slots to reconstruct corresponding written reasoning steps through an auxiliary decoder discarded at inference.

name: Pairwise Dictionary Mean Correlation Coefficient (PW-MCC)
description: Mean absolute decoder-vector cosine similarity under optimal one-to-one matching between independently learned dictionaries.

name: Non-negative efficient coding
description: Selecting non-negative representations that minimize activation energy under a fixed within-class population-variance constraint.

name: Hidden Token Attribution
description: Normalized source-wise derivative norms for a hidden vector or attention-head output, used to compare immediate-input and original-input sensitivity.

name: Subnetwork probing
description: Learning sparsity-regularized masks over a frozen encoder, together with a task head, to investigate linguistic structure through retained computations.

name: Feature-Effect Geometry Analysis (FEGA)
description: An offline framework for classifying cross-context clouds of reconstruction-relative SAE removal effects using downstream linear-logit geometry and family-specific stability checks.

name: Value-like and pointer-like feature roles
description: A proposed distinction between features associated with relatively static information and features associated with operations acting on context-dependent values; roles are operationalized through task-conditioned selection.

name: Attention Slipping
description: Declining final-prompt-position attention mass on a harmful-request segment as surrounding jailbreak context becomes effective.

name: Attention Sharpening
description: A defense that lowers attention softmax temperature to redistribute input-directed attention while intending to preserve its total mass.

name: Unsafe-prototype attention rate
description: Per-head, per-layer attention mass on the harmful-request segment divided by its attention mass without jailbreak context.

name: Pseudo Reverse Jailbreaking
description: Constructing synthetic jailbreak-degradation paths by replacing proportions of surrounding attack context with placeholder tokens.

name: Representational dissimilarity matrices
description: Symmetric condition-by-condition matrices recording pairwise response-pattern dissimilarities, used as representation signatures.

name: Second-order isomorphism
description: Correspondence between relationships among represented conditions, assessed by matching dissimilarity structures.

name: Condition-rich ungrouped-events design
description: Experimental design treating many individual stimuli as separate conditions, allowing evidence to be combined in different ways during analysis.

name: Condition resampling for RDM inference
description: Condition-label permutations for testing RDM relatedness and condition bootstrapping for estimating model-fit variability.

name: Task-grounded SAE taxonomy
description: A multi-label framework combining dictionary design, feature operation, and NLP function with experimental qualifiers.

name: Sparse Transformer testbed
description: TinyStories transformers with wide, TopK-gated MLPs whose native neurons provide a known structural reference dictionary for feature-recovery and compression studies.

name: Latent-thought gradient-subspace interventions
description: Position-specific SVD of example-wise loss gradients selects activation subspaces for projection ablation or amplification, compared with rank-matched random subspaces.

name: Analogous Feature Universality
description: The hypothesis that matched SAE feature subsets from different models exhibit similar relational geometry despite differences in individual feature representations.

name: MOSAIC
description: A framework linking VLM predictions to candidate training examples, shared sparse latents, and localized linguistic and visual evidence.

name: Latent-mediated training-data influence
description: Attribution of estimated training-example influence through sparse internal features and their position-wise activations.

name: Spatially structured multimodal sparse autoencoders
description: Shared image–text sparse dictionaries with region-based penalties encouraging localized visual support.

name: Phrase–region alignment
description: Contrastive alignment of pooled phrase and image-region latent responses using frozen attention to select positive correspondences.

name: EK-FAC influence estimation
description: Layerwise curvature-corrected gradient influence using a Kronecker eigenbasis and corrected eigenvalues.

name: RouterInterp
description: Explains MoE expert selection using routing-margin attribution to SAE features and feature-grouped routed versus non-routed contexts.

name: Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis
description: MoE experts receive heterogeneous collections of fine-grained micro-domains rather than a single semantically coherent domain.

name: Reproducible subspaces of unstable SAE features
description: Individually non-recurrent decoder directions can collectively occupy lower-effective-rank subspaces that recur across seeds.

name: Cross-seed feature pooling
description: Constructing an SAE by deduplicating features from multiple runs, selecting a fixed-size high-recurrence subset, and briefly tuning.

name: Clusterability regularization
description: Penalizing selected low-order normalized-Laplacian eigenvalues while normalizing ReLU neuron scales to discourage trivial rescaling solutions.

name: Clusterable initialization
description: Assigning hidden neurons random tags and initially strengthening same-tag connections while weakening different-tag connections.

name: Steering Hessian
description: Hessian of a behavioral objective with respect to an injected activation vector, analyzed through approximate eigenpairs.

name: Hessian-informed sharp removal
description: Subtracting a steering vector's projection onto an estimated large-absolute-eigenvalue Hessian subspace.

name: Ball and box threshold geometry
description: Support-function descriptions of dimension thresholds: marginal error counts use Euclidean balls, while universal shared-read reliability uses coordinate boxes.

name: Shared-read error dependence
description: Reuse of feature reads across gates correlates failures and can separate expected error counts from whole-output reliability.

name: Gaussian superposition threshold model
description: A controlled model combining independent Gaussian dictionary columns, uniformly random sparse Boolean supports, and affine threshold readouts.

name: Topic-specific personality editing
description: Changing the personality trait expressed in opinions about a selected topic while preserving responses on other topics.

name: PersonalityEdit
description: A benchmark of GPT-4-generated topic-specific opinions expressing Extraversion, Agreeableness, or Neuroticism.

name: Dense binary-weighted circuits
description: Dense ReLU circuits with approximately two input-weight values per neuron, where signed readouts combine overlapping neuron classes to recover Boolean functions.

name: Mutual Feature Regularization (MFR)
description: Parallel SAE training combining inactivity-triggered whole-model reinitialization with an auxiliary nearest-neighbor cosine agreement penalty between dictionaries.

name: Ridge-function feature models
description: Scalar functions expressed as sums of univariate responses to fixed linear projections.

name: Euclidean Fourier feature search
description: Searching Gaussian-reweighted Fourier space using mass estimates on progressively constrained slices to recover ridge directions.

name: Noisy function query learning
description: Recovering a function or its structure through chosen input queries to an oracle with bounded uniform error.

name: Deceptive attention training
description: Training attention mechanisms to suppress weights on designated tokens while retaining predictive information associated with those tokens.

name: Attention value norm compensation
description: Increasing attended representation magnitudes as a possible way to offset reduced attention weights.

name: Feature-specific error correction
description: Preferential sensitivity to individual feature directions while suppressing interference-like perturbations along their mixtures.

name: Activation plateaus
description: Regions around natural activations where small perturbations produce little downstream change.

name: Superellipse plateau-boundary fitting
description: Fitting axis-calibrated response-threshold contours to quantify sensitivity to individual directions versus two-direction mixtures.

name: Mechanistically eliciting latent behaviors (MELBO)
description: Unsupervised optimization of activation directions to maximize downstream activation changes.

name: Attention-output dimensional collapse
description: Concentration of multi-head attention-block output spectra into fewer effective dimensions than their ambient width; distinct from exact rank deficiency.

name: Active Subspace Initialization (ASI)
description: Initializing sparse dictionary directions within leading activation principal-component subspaces, with corresponding aligned encoder initialization.

name: Dead dictionary features
description: Sparse dictionary features that do not activate during an evaluation window; this paper uses 10 million tokens.

name: Entropy effective rank
description: The exponential Shannon entropy of singular values normalized by their sum, used to quantify spectral concentration.

name: PsychoBench
description: A framework administering thirteen psychological questionnaires to LLMs, with randomized question order, scale-specific scoring, and published human comparison samples.

name: PersonalityEdit
description: Benchmark used here for three personality categories and six directed response-personality conversions.

name: Probe-boundary personality editing
description: Conditional, per-token, layer-wise perturbation along a target personality classifier's weight vector toward a specified target score.

name: Joint Sparse Autoencoders
description: Separate modality-specific sparse encoder–decoder pairs trained on pooled vision and text activations with paired-code cosine alignment.

name: Multimodal feature alignment
description: Feature-level correspondence between paired visual and linguistic representations.

name: Gradient spillover between feature directions
description: The proposed unintended reinforcement of other features when an activation update follows an overlapping target-feature direction.

name: Geometry-aware data filtering
description: Removing fine-tuning examples whose hidden states are closest to toxicity-associated SAE decoder directions.

name: Superposition of perspectives
description: A behavioral metaphor describing an LLM as supporting multiple context-conditioned perspectives, including characters and non-character text-generating contexts.

name: Unexpected perspective shift
description: Changes in expressed questionnaire values or traits following context variations not deliberately designed to induce those changes.

name: Perspective controllability
description: The ability of a prompting method to induce targeted values or traits, operationalized by normalized target-minus-other questionnaire scores.

name: Questionnaire value stability
description: Evaluation of value-score stability through mean-level effect sizes, rank-order correlations, and within-profile ipsative correlations.

name: Cultural and personal value questionnaires
description: Adapted PVQ and VSM instruments used to score expressed personal and cultural values in language-model responses.

name: MonoSemanticity score (MS)
description: Activation-weighted average pairwise cosine similarity of image embeddings, excluding self-pairs, proposed as a neuron-level proxy for monosemanticity.

name: Parameter description complexity
description: The number of bits required to specify task-dependent parameters of a fixed computational architecture.

name: Superposed output channels
description: Routing inputs participating in an output operation into a shared sparse code so addition and nonlinear gating can detect their joint presence.

name: Feature influence
description: The number of output features that can change when an input feature is flipped under some assignment of the other inputs.

name: SPARC
description: Joint sparse autoencoders with stream-specific affine maps, shared index selection, and self- plus cross-reconstruction across model and modality streams.

name: Cross-stream Global TopK
description: Selects latent indices from summed stream encoder logits, then retains and rectifies each stream’s values at those indices. Common selected indices do not guarantee identical positive supports.

name: Open Images latent concept profiles
description: Label-frequency profiles of top-activating images, compared using generalized Jaccard similarity to measure cross-stream latent alignment.

name: Frozen-backbone linear visual adapter
description: A LiMBeR-style setup that trains only a linear projection from a frozen vision encoder into a frozen language model's input space.

name: Multilingual continued pretraining
description: Additional pretraining in another language, exemplified by Swallow's Japanese adaptation of Llama-2.

name: Layer-difference language shifts
description: Averaged late-minus-intermediate hidden-state differences used to shift vocabulary readouts between languages.

name: LIWC personality-language analysis
description: Dictionary-based psycholinguistic features measure associations between personality labels or scores and language use.

name: AI authorship disclosure
description: Informing readers that text was generated by AI can affect their quality judgments and personality inferences.

name: Frame theory
description: Mathematical study of redundant spanning vector systems, including tightness and coherence.

name: Binary support recovery
description: Exact identification of active binary features after linear encoding and biased ReLU decoding.

name: Equiangular tight frames
description: Unit-norm tight frames with equal absolute inner products between distinct vectors, attaining the Welch–Rankin coherence bound.

name: Dictionary coherence
description: Maximum absolute pairwise inner product between unit dictionary atoms, used to control feature interference.

name: HEXACO-60
description: A 60-item inventory measuring honesty-humility, emotionality, extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness to experience.

name: Human Values Scale
description: The European Social Survey's 21-item instrument measuring ten Schwartz values; administered here using gender-neutral descriptions and inverted scoring.

name: Code correctness representations
description: Internal representations associated with whether generated programs satisfy functional correctness criteria.

name: Mostly Basic Python Problems (MBPP)
description: A Python program-synthesis benchmark described here as containing 1,000 problems, evaluated using three visible tests per problem.

name: Structured Sparse AutoEncoder (S²AE)
description: A shared vision–language TopK SAE with visual-region exclusive and group sparsity penalties applied to binarized activation gates.

name: Attention and spatial patch grouping
description: Agglomerative image-patch clustering using row-normalized symmetrized all-layer attention distances multiplied by a power of normalized Manhattan distances.

name: Big Five Inventory (BFI)
description: The 44-item, five-point questionnaire used to assess Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism.

name: VL-SAE
description: A multimodal sparse autoencoder with a shared normalized-distance encoder, TopK sparsification, separate modality decoders, and an auxiliary contrastive alignment stage for large VLMs.

name: Soft-matching correlation
description: An optimal-transport coupling maximizing average unit-response correlation with uniform marginal masses; equal population sizes reduce to permutation matching.

name: Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD)
description: Natural-image fMRI dataset used here to evaluate prediction of high-level ventral-stream responses in four participants.

name: Prisma
description: A toolkit providing hooked vision and video transformers, sparse-coder training and evaluation, interventions, visualization, and released checkpoints.

name: SAE Boost
description: Domain adaptation through a supplementary sparse model that predicts a frozen SAE's reconstruction error from original activations and adds its decoded output during inference.

name: Deep causal transcoding
description: Approximating intervention-induced activation changes across a deep transformer slice with a shallow feature-factorized model.

name: Orthogonalized Gradient Iteration (OGI)
description: A heuristic exponential-DCT training procedure alternating input-factor orthogonalization with normalized causal-objective gradient updates.

name: Tensor decomposition
description: Factorizing higher-order derivative tensors into low-rank components to identify candidate input and output feature directions.

name: Persistent shallow circuits

name: IPIP-300 personality inventory

name: Combinatorial interpretability

name: Per-feature spectral measures

name: Emotion-induction prompting

name: Vision-language modality gap

name: Incidental polysemanticity

name: Activation L1 regularization

name: Missing and Extra Labels Tests

name: Concept imbalance in explanation evaluation

name: CircuitLasso

name: Grounded self-report

name: Spatial induction heads
